name: Parallel Volume Rendering with Static Load Balancing
definition: A parallel volume rendering algorithm for unstructured meshes that combines spatial partitioning with static load balancing to achieve high performance and reasonable efficiency with modest memory consumption on distributed-memory message-passing architectures.
summary: Parallel Volume Rendering with Static Load Balancing is a distributed algorithm for unstructured grids that uses view-independent spatial partitioning to minimize synchronization overhead and enable overlapping computation with compositing.
